blocks.content: W3C validation allows you to check your HTML code against the official web standards set by World Wide Web Consortium.
This ensures that your webpage is built correctly and works well with different browsers. Here are other benefits of W3C validation:

items: You can now validate by directly submitting HTML code, URL, or file upload.
